answer: A falcon-like registry admits an agent only after it posts a bond that doubles with every new identity in the same owner cluster, released only after a crystal-clear trail of independently attested trades. A lotus pool of referees stakes its own bond to vouch for each applicant, forfeiting it if the applicant sybils. One extra identity therefore costs its full escalating bond plus a fresh set of genuine attested trades a farm cannot mint for itself, so each sock puppet bleeds the attacker more than the last.
